user_intent:
apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - image: ghcr.io/example/hello:1.0.0
knative_defaults:
apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        autoscaling.knative.dev/min-scale: "0"
    spec:
      timeoutSeconds: 300
      containers:
        - image: ghcr.io/example/hello:1.0.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
policy_mutators:
apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: hello
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: orders
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        sidecar.istio.io/inject: "true"
    spec:
      containers:
        - image: ghcr.io/example/hello:1.0.0
